components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5b8cff; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; height: 36px; font: 14px/1 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Chrome recedes so the PDF page can do the work. The incumbent UI is a dark, mostly flat instrument panel: system UI fonts, hairline dividers, and a spare blue accent used for the thing that is currently in play. Density is for hours inside a technical manual, not for a marketing site. This file records the shipped look; a later redesign may replace this world.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only; no light theme in code.
Tonal stacking for structure; one shared drop shadow for floating chrome.
System sans; no display typeface except the empty-state wordmark.
8–12px corner radii on controls; the page stays rectangular.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue is for the current action or focus. Do not paint large surfaces blue.

rules.name: The Page Is Not Chrome Rule
rules.body: The PDF sheet stays paper-white from the document; chrome never tints the page.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce Inter, a second display face, or icon fonts for chrome.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat until they float over the page.

dos: Do keep chrome dark and the PDF page paper-white.
Do use 信号蓝 only for the live control or focus.
Do slide the sidebar as a whole; never animate inner text width.
Do collapse a closed sidebar to zero flex width so the page recenters.
donts: Don't introduce a light theme or purple SaaS gradient.
Don't nest cards inside cards on the reading surface.
Don't add Inter, icon-tile headers, or bounce easing.
Don't put Chat chrome in the reader; translation stays 划词.
